Title: Joetsu-Arai Sushi Chef Experience
Description:
14:00-16:00 Sushi Chef Experience 

Sushi making experience in Myoko City, Niigata Prefecture!

Why don't you join us to make delicious sushi using delicious fish from the Sea of Japan at an authentic sushi restaurant? "Taisho" (Owener-Chef) will teach you how to make professional nigiri sushi directly and kindly! We look forward to welcoming you!

When the nigirizushi is ready, let's say "Itadakimasu" together and enjoy the delicious sushi.

*Included

　Cuisine---Nigirizushi, grilled fish, steamed rice in a bowl, miso soup, salad, tea

　Tour guide

　Sushi chef costume and hat

*What is not included

　Sake and drinks are not included.

Title: Joetsu Cycling Tour C: Cycling course to visit the traces  of the railroad while feeling the  wind of the Sea of Japan
Description:
Course Details

Starting from Naoetsu, the birthplace of Niigata Prefecture's railroad system. 

You can proceed to the Kubiki Bicycle Path along the coast, taking in the scenery of the Gotsu Coast that appears as you pass through the town. 

Then, from there, you can ride through the scenery with retro station buildings and railroads, or ride along the seaside path along the Kubiki 

Bicycle Path, which was built on the site of a former railroad line. The goal of the cycling course, which is full of photo spots, is Umiterasu 

Nadachi. At Umiterasu Nadachi,you can shop for souvenirs and marine products, and enjoy hot springs after the tour.

Notes
